messages.subject: Error in dbinom
parts:
Can anyone help me interpret this error?

When I run:

nll -= dbinom(Resighted(i), Marked(i), p(i), true);

I get:

test.cpp:70:10: error: no matching function for call to 'dbinom'
  nll -= dbinom(Resighted(i), Marked(i), p(i), true);
         ^~~~~~

Resighted and Marked are vectors of integers. p is a vector or probabilities between 0 and 1.  If I replace data with numbers, the code works fine. 

Thank you for any guidance.

-- Chris

Hi Chris,

I just looked at how I usually use dbinom. 
Try reading in Resighted and Marked as DATA_VECTOR, assuming that they are data. Otheriwse try defining them as vector<Type>

I think TMB will know they’re integers.

cheers,
Mollie
